user.title: Connect to ParentVUE
user.description: Connect Home Assistant directly to your district's ParentVUE website.

data_description.base_url: Use the district base URL, for example https://va-cps-psv.edupoint.com. HTTPS is required.
data_description.password: Your normal ParentVUE website password. It is stored in Home Assistant's config entry and is never exposed as an entity.

error.invalid_url: Enter a valid HTTPS ParentVUE district URL.
error.invalid_auth: The ParentVUE username or password was rejected.
error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach the ParentVUE server.
error.unsupported_deployment: This ParentVUE website deployment is not currently supported.
error.endpoint_unavailable: A required ParentVUE website endpoint is not available.
error.no_students: No students were found for this ParentVUE account.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred while connecting to ParentVUE.

abort.already_configured: This ParentVUE account is already configured.

invalid_auth.message: ParentVUE authentication failed. Reauthentication is required.
